items.label: Package Includes
items.value: You can receive 8 packs three-legged peony support cages, which can flexibly meet support needs for different plants. All supports feature a ring-shaped lattice top design, enabling plants to grow naturally through center and develop evenly

items.label: Practical Size
items.value: Each peony support ring measures about 12’’ in diameter and 15.7’’ in height, offering stable support for variety top-heavy or large-headed plants, shrubs, and vines, like heavy-fruited tomatoes, as well as peonies, begonias, and more

items.label: Sturdy Material
items.value: These plant supports are constructed from sturdy iron wire with a green powder coating. Weather-resistant and built to last for years, their green color blends naturally with your plants for secure support

items.label: Prevent Plant Lodging
items.value: Peony support cages can provide sturdy support for flowers and plant preventing lodging. This supports set is designed to help your peonies and other various plants maintain an upright and healthy growth

items.label: Easy to Install
items.value: Designed for effortless setup, these peony support structures can be assembled quickly through simply placing a three outer legs around each structure top's outer ring, then pressing them 4–6 inches into the soil. This detachable design also makes them easy to remove and store, saving space when not needed
